subject.title: [Bug]: Hundreds of repeated HTTP requests to 169.254.169.254:80 for the first 10 minutes after the startup

question: Should OpenClaw accept the linked Bedrock credential-gate behavior that skips IMDS for no-signal memory auto-detection while preserving IMDS/default-chain probing for explicit Bedrock configurations?
rationale: This is a real bug, but the fix changes an auth-provider and metadata-service boundary where existing EC2/ECS/SSO/profile users could be affected if the allowance rules are wrong.

options.title: Land the linked Bedrock-local fix
options.body: Accept the PR's split between no-signal auto-detection and explicit Bedrock configurations once maintainer compatibility/security review is satisfied.

options.title: Ask for more live proof first
options.body: Keep the PR open until maintainers or the contributor provide NemoClaw sandbox and EC2/ECS/default-chain proof.

options.title: Choose a different credential policy
options.body: Reject or revise the PR if maintainers want a stricter or more configurable IMDS policy than the current Bedrock-local gate.

recommendation.title: Land the linked Bedrock-local fix
recommendation.body: Accept the PR's split between no-signal auto-detection and explicit Bedrock configurations once maintainer compatibility/security review is satisfied.
